text:
mira: Heads-up — during a live POC demo we started getting intermittent 429s for the embeddings route. Customer saw drops at t+45s of the test.

alex: Can you paste the error payload / headers? sounds like a per-route token budget hit or burst cap.

mira: Here is the error we get from the client stack: 
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Content-Type: application/json
X-Request-Id: rq_abc123
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
X-Token-Budget: 0/500
{
  "error": "token_budget_exhausted",
  "message": "per-route token budget exceeded for tenant: acme-demo-01"
}
```

mira: Our POC load is mostly parallel bulk-embed calls (100 concurrent small batches).

jordan: That X-Token-Budget header is the clue. Looks like the per-route budget drained very quickly because concurrent calls didn't share a prefix cache. Was caching/kv enabled?

mira: KV caching is on but route is /v1/embeddings and we do unique inputs so caching doesn't help. The account has a per-route cap configured by sales for demo isolation: per_route_tokens=500/min, burst_window=60s.

sam: Quick mitigations: 1) temporarily raise per_route cap for acme-demo-01, 2) enable short-lived reservation for the demo (reserve 600 tokens for 5m), or 3) apply client-side retry with jitter to spread concurrency. Which do you prefer?

mira: Need something ASAP for next 10 mins. Can we do a temporary bump? Also want to collect logs for root cause.

alex: I can grant a temporary burst bump from the sales console — need tenant id + desired burst amount. If we do +1000 tokens for 10m should cover it. Note: bumping changes billing.

mira: Tenant: acme-demo-01. Please bump to +1000 for 10 minutes. Also, can we get per-request latency / token accounting to see which calls consumed most tokens?

alex: @quota-bot we need a manual per-route token bump: tenant=acme-demo-01 delta=+1000 duration=600s reason="POC live demo"

quota-bot: Request received. Creating temporary reservation... (this may take up to 20s) :hourglass: 

quota-bot: Temporary reservation applied: tenant=acme-demo-01 reserved_tokens=1000 expires_in=600s. Billing alert sent to finance. :white_check_mark:

mira: Confirmed — demo continued, no 429s for the remainder of the session. Thanks.

jordan: Follow-ups for permanent fix: - reduce client concurrency or batch size - enable shared prefix batching if possible - increase per-route steady-state cap for the account if their workload stays this way - enable token-rate smoothing (longer window) so burst drains slower

sam: Also create a short runbook for presales: how to request temporary reservations, expected billing impacts, and which telemetry to collect (x-token-budget, request_id, model, token_count). I'll draft one and attach after standup.

mira: Attaching quick logs in thread for postmortem. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
